title: 美国成屋销售回落至三个月低点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How can you be good and bad news at the same time? You have existing home sales coming in ahead of forecasts up by 4,000,000 on an annual basis,
segments.zh: 怎么同时是好消息又是坏消息？现有房屋销售年化超出预期，达到400万套，

segments.en: but that's down because last month was revised higher to 4,130,000.
segments.zh: 但比上月下调后的413万套有所下降。

segments.en: So good news and bad news at the same time. It's a 1.7 percent decline month over month from June to July.
segments.zh: 所以同时是好消息和坏消息。从6月到7月，环比下降1.7%。

segments.en: Now, why is that? Well, of course, it's the same old problem.
segments.zh: 原因何在？当然，还是老问题。

segments.en: And this is where we link back to the Fed and CPI. It's mortgage rates.
segments.zh: 这就联系到美联储和CPI了，就是房贷利率。

segments.en: Mortgage rates are continuing to rise after having fallen before the war started, but as the market rates go up, mortgage rates go up.
segments.zh: 房贷利率在战前下降后持续上升，随着市场利率上升，房贷利率也上升。

segments.en: And that is, again, crimping demand for housing.
segments.zh: 这再次抑制了住房需求。

segments.en: Nobody wants to get out of their old cheap mortgage.
segments.zh: 没人愿意放弃自己原有的低利率房贷。

segments.en: So tomorrow, one of the things we'll be watching. And this is where I, you know, promo our CPI coverage in the CPI is housing.
segments.zh: 明天我们将关注CPI中的住房分项，这也是我们CPI报道的重点。

segments.en: And it's one of the areas that has actually been going down in the amount of increase in prices.
segments.zh: 这是价格上涨幅度实际上一直在下降的领域之一。

segments.en: That's the way to put it, I guess, for inflation. From April, we saw fairly high numbers.
segments.zh: 我想这就是通胀的表述方式。从四月起，我们看到相当高的数字。

segments.en: And then all the way to June, down to one tenth of a percent for rent and two tenths for owners equivalent rent, which is basically the price of houses.
segments.zh: 然后一直到六月，租金降至0.1%，业主等价租金降至0.2%，这基本上反映了地产市场。

segments.en: And so we're anticipating we're going to get something similar to that this time.
segments.zh: 所以我们预计这次也会出现类似情况。

segments.en: And some people will say, well, okay, let's cut rates and bring mortgage rates down.
segments.zh: 有些人会说，好吧，让我们降息并降低房贷利率。

segments.en: But that's up to the fit.
